Docs.summary: Defines the synchronous validation behavior for this attribute.

returns.para: An instance of when validation is invalid.

remarks.para: Synchronous validation consumers invoke this method. Provide a synchronous implementation when it can evaluate the applicable rule. Return a validation error when the rule rejects the value. If an applicable, required rule cannot be evaluated synchronously, throw with a message directing callers to an asynchronous validation entry point. An unsupported invocation does not establish that the value is invalid.

Return without evaluating the rule only when the rule does not apply, or when the synchronous pass is explicitly advisory and a separate, required asynchronous validation step governs acceptance. Success does not indicate pending validation or arrange a later asynchronous invocation. Do not return success merely because a required asynchronous check cannot run.

Do not implement this method by blocking on asynchronous work, such as by using Task<TResult>.Result, Task.Wait(), or GetAwaiter().GetResult(). Wrapping the operation in Task.Run does not make a blocking wait appropriate.
